text:
Supplemental publicly available domain documentation (analyst paraphrases of the cited primary sources; not original BIRD metadata):
MTGJSON Card (Set) data model
frameVersion is a string property identifying the card frame style.
Source: https://mtgjson.com/data-models/card/card-set/

The Future Is Now, Part I (2007-04-09)
Wizards describes Future Sight timeshifted cards as using a specially designed futuristic frame. The article illustrates Fleshwrither and explains that this design represents a fictional future, rather than an announced replacement for normal frames.
Source: https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/making-magic/future-now-part-i-2007-04-09

Days of Core, Part 2 (2014-06-30)
Wizards states that Magic 2015 premiered updated card faces as part of a card-frame change.
Source: https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/making-magic/days-core-part-2-2014-06-30

Magic 2015 Core Set Release Notes (2014-07-07)
Wizards gives July 18, 2014 as the official release date of Magic 2015.
Source: https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/feature/magic-2015-core-set-release-notes-2014-07-07
